evidence.epochs: The admitted corpus design fixes three passes: approximately 63M rendered tokens per epoch and 189M total, or 0.95% of the 20B-token base run.
evidence.examples_per_update: The 300-conversation pilot measured 649 rendered tokens per SFT row. 32 rows therefore estimate 20,768 rendered tokens per update while keeping the formal run below 10,000 optimizer updates for the expected 95,000-row corpus.
evidence.learning_rate: Linear token-batch transfer from the pinned pretraining point gives 8.825e-4 * (32 * 649) / 1,310,720 = 1.397e-5. The formal 1e-5 peak stays below that transferred ceiling because completion-only gradients cover fewer tokens than rendered-token count.
evidence.optimizer: Keep the base run's Muon matrix domain, AdamW residual domain, momentum, Nesterov, NS5, decay and QK-Clip contracts so SFT changes the data objective rather than the optimizer definition.
evidence.warmup: Use the same K3-declared 1% update warmup policy as pretraining, resolved as ceil(total_updates * 0.01) after the admitted dataset fixes total_updates.
evidence.scheduler: Cosine decay to 0.1 of peak is continuous with the single formal pretraining schedule; no WSD or linear alternative is introduced.
